messages:
Alice Chen: Heads up — finalizing reg page. Need calendar CTA that adds a timezone-aware invite and a short bumper recording to upload to Zoom before we go live. Who can do the invite link + recording?
Marcos Rivera: I can handle the calendar invite + iCal. Will add timezone auto-detect. For the bumper: speaker slate or animated logo?
Priya Singh: Speaker slate + 5s animated logo, keep under 20s total. Also need captioning enabled and cloud recording on separate tracks for each participant.
Jamie Park: Zoom settings I'm planning: cloud recording (active speaker + gallery), audio transcript on, record active speaker + shared screen. Pasting the config we should use: 
```
Cloud Recording: enabled
Recordings: Active Speaker + Shared Screen + Gallery (if available)
Audio Transcript: enabled (auto)
Separate audio files for participants: enabled
Auto-delete: disabled
```
Marcos Rivera: Got it. Alice — do we want the calendar CTA to also capture utm params and campaign id for HubSpot?
Alice Chen: Yes — utm_source and campaign required. Also need hidden field 'benchmark_variant' to split A/B messaging.
Marcos Rivera: Will create CTA button that opens modal with 'Add to calendar' and POSTs to /api/track_reg with hidden fields. Leaving draft for review in the CMS.
Priya Singh: Post-event flow: auto-send full recording + a 30s highlight (bumper + key clip) and short survey. HubSpot workflow should tag leads as `video_sent` and bump lead score +10.
Luis Ortega: Ops note — let's warm Zoom instances 10 min before start with a short keepalive recording to avoid cold-start glitches.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Zoom meeting ID 987-654-321 will start warmup recording at 2026-06-15T08:20:00Z. Cloud recording and transcription toggled.
Jamie Park: Quick note on transcripts: we need to export VTT from Zoom and push to S3 path `s3://redwood-event/recordings/1769502468/` then trigger the transcript-merge job. I'll add the Lambda hook.
Marcos Rivera: CTA landed on staging: /register?ref=benchmark-launch. Calendar invite created: https://cal.redwood.com/ev/17695. Bumper uploaded: s3://redwood-assets/bumper_v2.mp4. Campaign hidden field named `benchmark_variant`.
Alice Chen: Perfect. Last thing — QA on mobile add-to-calendar. I couldn't repro on iOS earlier. Assigning to @Priya. :eyes:
Priya Singh: On it. Testing iPhone + Android now, will report back in ~30m.
Marcos Rivera: FYI I added a small fallback link (download .ics) for Safari users who block calendar popups.
Alice Chen: Awesome — thanks team. Once Priya confirms mobile flows, we can flip the live switch and kick the pre-event email sequence. :thumbsup:
